summary: @servicetitan/micro-frontend preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style variable names to build a URL against github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, downloads the Bun runtime zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary 0755, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line file marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' containing a shuffled string/number lookup array, a push/shift rotator, hex-prefixed identifier names, and a custom base64-alphabet decoder — no readable code. math_init.js is not listed in package.json's 'files' array. The package's advertised purpose is 'micro-frontend integration'; fetching a second language runtime at npm install time to execute an obfuscated sibling script is not consistent with that purpose and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
